tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// phag mo lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga bzhugs so//

༄༅// rig byed brah+ma yi bum pa'i chus// rig byar tshul min rtog pa ngan bkrus nas// rig ma'i skyes bur dbang bskur rgyal thabs kyi// rig pa'i mkhan po thams cad phyag bya'i 'os// slob dpon chen po nges par sbyangs pa gnyis med rdo rjes cho ga ji lta ba bzhin bris pa'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ram/ bris sku la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pas dmigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa la sogs pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor la mchod do// de nas dgongs kyi dus su bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa bshams te dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bcu gsum gyi bdag nyid can lhag par gnas par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i bris sku ni ras bris dang*/ sogs sgras blos bslangs dang tshom bu/ mngon par rtogs pas ni yid kyi dkyil 'khor bstan la/ de dag gang du dbang bskur yang ras bris lta bu na de bkram/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ rnam rgyal bum pa mtshan ldan nang rdzas nyer lnga chus sum gnyis bkang ba/ steng du rnam rgyal chen po thod pa dang rdo rje la gzungs thag btags pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa/ las bum dang po la gtso bo dang*/ gnyis par de'i lha'i dbang po'i phyag mtshan bris pa stegs bu gtsang mar bshams la phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga ji lta bas bsgrubs te/ nub dang po la slob ma sta gon tsam mo// bla mas rjes su 'dzin par khas blangs pa'i snod rung gi slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la bsgrigs te/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla mas gsang sngags dngos grub don gnyer gang*// bsod nams 'dod pa de las gzhan// 'jig rten pha rol la gzhol ba// kha cig dkyil 'khor 'di 'jug byed// 'jig rten gzhan don 'dod pa yi// blo bzang dad pa cher byas 'jug /'jig rten 'di yi 'bras spangs nas// 'jig rten gzhan don la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// 'di las 'jig rten gzhan gyi min// de phyir 'jig rten gzhan dag gi

/dngos grub tu ni yid brtan gyis// zhes pas nyan par gdams/ tsher ma can gyi shing la me sbar lag pa gnyis su yungs kar bzung ste g.yas dang g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya ma ma sarba bi sh+ya s+ya pā paṃ da ha na swāhā/ zhes brjod me la dor/ de bzhin chu la yang sbyangs chu de bgegs gtor ting lo chang bur bcas pa'i khrod du blugs te phyi rol tu dor ro// slob ma de rnams dpal rdo rje btsun mo'i gzugs su rang gi kha nas zhugs/ a wa dhū tī nas pad+ma'i nang du song ba rnams la snying ga'i sa bon gyis 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug ste zhu ba'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur/ phyir 'thon dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su gnas pas 'jug par gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rnal 'byor ma mchog kha sbyor ba'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa// mgon po chen por bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang po dang*// de bzhin phag mo he ru ka /gsang ba'i gnas sogs yang dag gang*// lus la rnam gnas bshad du gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// de nas slob ma gcig gtso bor byas te/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam nyid des// skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten rjes 'jug bcad nas ni// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ces spro ba bskyed/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrung ba dang bsang gtor byas la/ zla ba la gnas pa'i snying gar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥ spyi bor 'khor lo la oṃ/ dris snying mgrin dpral ba gsum du thig le bya/ de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis mkha' spyod ma dang sa spyod ma dang sa 'og na gnas pa rnams spyan drangs te gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes yas rim gyis thig le bya/ nyer mchod lngas mchod/ de nas so shing sor bcu gnyis pa las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pa byin/ tshom bu lnga pa'i dbus su 'dor du bcug /phyogs zhi sogs/ mtshams phran tshegs/ rang la kha bstan na mchog /thur sa 'og /gyen du bltas na mkha' spyod/ phyi rol tu lhung na skal ba med pas bskyar ro// de'i rjes su khyor chu/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharma sarba pā pā ni tsā s+ya bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa a pa nā ya hūm̐/ lan gsum 'thungs te lhag ma rgyab tu dor/ las thams cad pa lan bdun bzlas pa'i ku sha che stan/ chung ba sngas su sbyin/ skud pa sngo dmar sum sgril la sngags de lan bdun btab mdud pa gsum byas dpung pa g.yas su bcings te dri chus rdo rje rgya gram gyi rnam pas byin gyis brlabs/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum+ba ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa bgyis pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di ni mthong ba yis// de dag thams cad zad 'gyur na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags brjod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gro// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo ba// de dag kun gyi ngan 'gro'i rgyun// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa// bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung nas skye bzhin pas// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la// legs par skye bar 'gyur ba yin// zhes chos bshad de/

slar yang las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis legs par bsrungs la/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur mchog /stsal nas mgon pos bdag la ni// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang*// gsang ba mchog gi dam tshig ni// sdom pa gsang ba bla na med// rtag tu sems can kun don phyir// slob dpon du 'gyur bdag la gsungs// de nas bla mas mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ che ge mo zhes bya ba 'di/ byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin zhing*// gsang ba'i don gyi 'khor lo 'dir// dam tshig sdom la 'jug par 'tshal// de nas slob mar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i// gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni// bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam// zhes brjod slob mas kyang*/ bdag ni rab tu de 'tshal lo// zhes khas blangs/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// bla ma mchod dang de bzhin byams// sangs rgyas la gus 'gro la byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// mi dge la sogs las rnams spangs// rtsa ba'i ltung ba yongs spangs shing*// sbom po'i ltung ba'ang de bzhin no// sems can rnams ni mchod par bya// theg pa dman la 'dod pa'ang min// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar gyis// ma grol ba rnams grol bar gyis// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'khrugs pa las// sems can dbugs ni dbyung bar gyis// sems can don byed tshul khrims kyang*// rtag tu khyod kyis so sor gzung*// zhes brjod slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// rmi lam ci mthong ba nga la smros shig ces brjod nas dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa der nyal du 'jug /ngan na sbyin sreg gis bzlog go /nang par gtor ma btang ltas bzang na de smin par bya ba'i phyir/ phyi rol mchod pa nas bum pa sgrub pa'i bar byas/

bdag 'jug blang*/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i phyir bden pa brjod pa ni/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las la kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin kho na nyid las skyes// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /slob dpon smin par bya ba'i cho ga'o// da ni slob ma smin par bya ba'i las rim bshad par bya/ 'jug pa dang dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ yol ba'i phyir slob ma khrus byas yon phul/ skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad du gyur/ āḥkhaṃ wī ra hūm̐ me tog gi 'phreng ba gtad/ gdong g.yogs dmar po bcings/ las thams cad pa'i bum chus bsangs nas/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dri ba bya ste/ bu khyod su yin/ des/ bdag bde ba chen po'i skal ba dang ldan pa lags so// zhes lan gdab/ slob mas oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ lan gsum/ bla mas de'i snying gar rdo rje bkod nas/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dh+ya badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas byang chub tu sems bskyed/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/ khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar ma byed cig /ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid+yā ma hā bid+yā rā dza dhi ma he swāhā/ 'dis yol ba'i nang du bcug /dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyis ngas khyod la rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya yi/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/

byas na bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ rdo rje spyi bor bkod/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te khyod kyis tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro// de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje snying gar bzhag /oṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// mna' bgags/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha/ lan bdun bzlas te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// hub gsum 'thung du gzhug /byin dbab pa'i phyir zhal bzhi pa'i sngags kyis phyogs bsrungs la/ slob ma mngon rtogs bzhin gtso mor bskyed go cha bskon/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung gru gsum pa'i lte bar baṃ la snying po nye snying bkod pa rab tu 'bar ba'i zur gsum la g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan pa gsal bar bsgoms la/ slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas sha chen bud med kyi rdul gu gul dang sbyar bas bdug /rol mo drag po dang bcas pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha badz+ra wā rā hi ā be sha ya s+t+waṃ bhā ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsā la ya/ tsā la ya/ hūm̐ haḥ.aḥdzhaiṃḥbabs nas/ de'i lce la āḥyig dmar po bsams la/ gsung gi rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod// bu yi dge dang mi dge smros// oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya pa tī pā li te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swāhā/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la brtan par bya'o// de'i rjes la slob ma rnams g.yon bskor gyis dkyil 'khor la lan gsum bskor du bcug /dkyil 'khor 'di ni dngos grub ste// mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// bu khyod nga yis bkug pa yin// bde chen gyi gtso bo la lho sgo nas/

oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ oṃ na maḥme hūm̐/ oṃ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ dpal ldan mkha' 'gro mchog gis mgul nas 'khyud// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma sogs gnyis med sku// rdo rje btsun mo thugs rje'i stobs kyis gzigs// bla ma mchog dang gnyis med la phyag 'tshal// slar shar sgor/ gti mug gis mnan 'gro mthong nas// gti mug thams cad zhi bya'i phyir// lha mo mkha' 'gro ma gzugs 'dzin// de phyir mkha' 'gro ma khyod 'dud// byang*/ phrag dog lā ma'i/ nub/ 'dod chags/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'i/ dum skyes/ lhor/ nga rgyal gyis/ nga rgyal thams cad/ gzugs can ma gzugs/ de phyir gzugs can/ bde chen la/ he ru ka dang gnyis su med// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar bcas la// phyag 'tshal 'dud cing khyod phyag 'tshal// de'i rjes la khyod kyi mig sngar ci snang*/ ji ltar mthong ba'i mdangs brjod pas las gang gi snod brda sprad/ slob dpon gyis/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bya// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag /bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog /'di yis dngos grub gang 'grub dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di yis bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /slob mas cod pan trāṃ dang hūm̐ bzlas pa/ dkyil 'khor du pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes pas dor/ gang la babs pa de'i rigs dang dngos grub thob par brda sprad/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lhas slob ma'i mgor bcing*/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa twaṃ/ sarba ma hā ba la/ mig gnyis su yi ge oṃ gzi brjid 'bar ba bsam/ rdo rje btsun mo deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// gdong g.yogs bkrol/ 'di ni rdo rje phag mo lha bcu gsum ma rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'o zhes bstan/

gnyis pa dbang la bum dbang sogs bzhi las dang po la/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod sbyin ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas lan gsum du gsol ba gdab/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho ྅haṃ gis bsang gtor byas/ mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing dar dang rin po ches spras te rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur// slob dpon gyi snying kha'i sa bon las byung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis byas la/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis rnam rgyal bum pa spyi bor bkod nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ khrus byas/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bur dbang bskur ba 'di ni chu'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ste me long lta bu'i ye shes so// slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ rdo rje nyi ma sku mdog dmar po rin po che dang dril bu nas/ trāṃ yig las skyes pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin gyi cod pan gyis dbang*/ dbang bskur rdo rje/ oṃ badz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñcā mi/ mgo la bzhag nam mkha'i dbyings na gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rigs kyi gtso bo'i gzugs kyis dbu brgyan pa bzhugs par gyur/ cod pan gyis dbang bskur ba ste mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so// slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'od dpag med sku mdog mthing ka pad+ma dang hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje dang*/

sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun nas rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis bzung*// rdo rje snying gar reg ste lag pa g.yas su gtad/ rdo rje'i dbang ste so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so// bsangs sbyangs/ rta mchog ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ a las skyes pa'i dril bu bla ma'i gzugs su dmigs pas/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ lag pa g.yon pas 'khyud cing dkrol/ bdag po'i dbang ste bya ba grub pa'i ye shes so// bsangs sbyangs/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog ser po 'khor lo dang*/ mgo bor rdo rje dril bu bzung bas/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa a bhi ṣiñca mi badz+ra nā ma bhi ṣe ka ta kye dpal he ru ka sogs kyi rigs gang yin pa de'i ming btags ming gi dbang bskur ba ste chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa'i ye shes so// brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can// sangs rgyas lnga yi rang bzhin phyir// des na dang por dbang lnga ni// sbyin bya bde ba sgrub byed pa'o// gcig kyang du ma nyid kyi gzugs// gar ni sangs rgyas nyid kyi gar// sangs rgyas gang dang gang bsgom pa// he ru ka pa'i go 'phang gnas// 'di rnams kyis ni sngags dang rgyud la sogs pa mnyan pa la dbang bar 'gyur ro// de dag rig pa'i dbang ngo*// ci 'byor bas bla ma mchod cing shin tu gus pas zhabs la gtugs pa'i phyag byas snying kha'i g.yon du thal mo sbyar nas/ kye ho thugs rje'i gter bdag nyid// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// khyod kyi bka' drin gyis bdag la// rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur stsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ lho sgor gdugs dkar po lha mos bzung ba'i 'og tu seng ge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la/ slob ma gtso bor bskyed/ byin brlabs go bskon/

slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis cang te'u la sogs pa'i rol mo dang*/ bkra shis pa'i glu dang mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod par byed cing*/ bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i chu'i dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis byas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po sogs brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// mkha' 'gro dra ba kun gyi bdag /rdo rje snyems ma bdag po'i bdag /ces pas g.yas su 'dzin du gzhug /'di ni rdo rje'i dam tshig go /a las skyes pa'i dril bu/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu gzung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// g.yon du sbyin/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes pas dkrol/ dril bu'i dam tshig go /yid kyi lus ni brten bya'i phyir// phyag rgya dam tshig ces bshad de// gang gi lus ni brtan byed pa// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes bsnol du bcug /phyag rgya'i dam tshig go /de nas sdom pa'i phyag rgya'i brtul zhugs sbyin par bya ste/ 'khor lo'i gzugs kyi mi bskyod pa// rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med// mgul gyi 'phreng ba rin chen dbang*// lag gdub rnam par snang mdzad de// ska rags la ni don yod gnas// thal ba rdo rje sems dpa' nyid// drug po de dag phyag rgyar shes// sbyin pa sogs la rab 'jug pa// kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni lha yi sku// shes rab ḍa ma ru yi sgra// nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can// shes rab la ni mtshan mor brjod// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// 'dod chags bzhi bum dbang ngam bzhi pa'i mthar ster ba gdam ngag las/

da res 'dir bya ste/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ slob ma dpal he ru ka nag por dmigs la/ 'di ste dpa' bo thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka yi brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī s+t+waṃ sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ka ya s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi swāhā/ rdo rje lag pa g.yas su gtad do// de nas slob dpon khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// lhan skyes thabs kyi mtshan nyid ni// dpal ldan bde mchog las gzhan med// sdom pa mchog ni srung bar gyis// dbugs dbyung ngo*// sdom pa dngos grub rgyu yi phyir// mkhas pas sbyor ba gzhan du min// he ru ka dpal nga rgyal gyis// na dang ga dang de bzhin ha// mthar sha dang po sha de bzhin// bdud rtsi lnga dang mnyam ldan pa'i// bza' btung rtag tu spyad par gyis// legs mchod dril sgra sna tshogs pas// legs bstod bdud rtsi'i btung bas tshim// dam tshig sbyin pa'o// de nas mchod de/ slob ma gtso bor/ bla mas rang gi snying gar nyi ma la sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng ba bskor ba de las sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'phros pa rang gi zhal nas slob ma'i khar zhugs/ snying khar thim pa'i mos pas sngags brgya rtsa brgyad lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ bdag gis khyod la bcom ldan 'das// stsal gyis 'di la nye bar mdzod// ces rdo rje dang bcas pa'i me tog spyi bor bkod/ bdag gis bcom ldan gzung lags kyis// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum rjes zlos bya/ 'dis sngags kyi dngos grub kyi skal ba dang ldan par 'gyur ro// de'i rjes la gdugs dang bcas/ slob ma ḍa ma ru thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzung ste phyag rgyas brgyan la dkyil 'khor mchog dang bla ma la bskor ba bya zhing zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te/ gang gis bka' stsal pa de thams cad bdag gis bgyi'o// zhes brjod par bya'o// de rnams dbang bcu'i cho ga'o// de nas gsang dbang gi don du shes rab ma bla ma la phul te maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pas/ skyob pa med pa rnams kyi skyabs// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi// bltos med thugs rje chen po yi// bdag cag rnams kyi mgon mdzod cig /kye ho mgon gtso khyed rnams kyis// theg chen ting 'dzin ji lta bar// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bdag bying 'di las bdag la skyobs// gdong bcing*/

bla ma yab yum he ru ka yab yum gyi rnam par chags pa chen pos snyoms par zhugs pas lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang pad+ma nas sbyin par mos te/ hrīḥji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// rdo rje 'dzin sogs dbang bskur ltar// byang chub sems ni mdzes pa yis// de bzhin bu khyod dbang bskur ro// slob mas kyang*/ rtag pa'i rnal 'byor sangs rgyas zhu ba'i dbang du rig nas a hoḥsu kha zhes longs spyod kyis blang bar bya'o// dngos su bdud rtsi sbyin/ de nas phan yon brjod pa ni/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dbang bskur cho ga mchog gyur pa// gsung gi rdo rje rnam dag pas// sngags rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// gdong bkrol/ gsang dbang ngo*// maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pas sngar bzhin gsol ba btab ste gdong g.yogs/ shes rab ma de'i lag par sprad nas/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dpang por byas te rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad par bya// brdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya// ma byin par yang khyod kyis long*// lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che// bde ba mtha' yas ster byed ma// blangs nas bu yis dus kun tu// bla na med pa'i mchod pa gyis// zhes brjod/ lha mo des/ dpa' bo bu khyod ci la spro// byang chub sems ni bza' ba dang*// rigs lnga las ni yang dag byung*// rig ma gus pas yang dag mchod// bshang gci stobs dang dri chen sogs// de ni so sor za ba dang*// gzhan yang mdzes pa'i dam tshig rnams// ji ltar spro ba bu yis smros/ slob mas/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// dam tshig thams cad gzung bar bgyi// bya ba rtag tu cis mi gus// bud med pad+ma cis mi mchod// de gos dang bral bas pad+ma rgyas pa bstan nas/ kye ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// e ma ho gang zhig cho gas sten byed pa// bdag ni de yi mdun na gnas// bde ba'i mchod la sogs pa ni// ji ltar bya ba pad+mar bgyi// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid la ni rtag tu gnas// he ru ka pa yab yum du bsams pa'i gnas lngar oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā 'bar ba'i yi ge sangs rgyas lngar mos pas byin gyis a dang hūm̐ las skyes pa'i pad+ma dang rdo rje oṃ dang phaṭ kyis mtshan pa/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes rjes su chags pa brtsams pa'i sa bon kha sbyar gyi dbus su lhan cig skyes pa 'char ba mngon sum du rig par bya'o// byang chub sems ni mi 'dor ba// de srid rnal 'byor pa yis bya// de srid rgyun mi 'chad pa 'thob// dga' las skyes pa'i sdom pa ci// zhes brjod/ bla ma'i snying ga'i sa bon gyis bkug pa'i phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par spyan drangs pa slob ma'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus thams cad du zhugs pas bde chen du gyur/ slob ma'i bde ba 'bab pa de la bltas nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po sogs brjod pa'i mthar de kho na nyid kyi bde ba bskyed par bya'o// de nas byang chub chen po'i sems dpa' che// zung ma 'di ni bde ba che// ji srid byang chub ma thob pa// rdor 'dzin sems can don rnams kyi// ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyed rang yang ni de yi pha// phyir lhung na pad+ma nas lces btung bar bya'o// dbang gsum pa'o// bzhi pa la maṇ+ḍal dang sngar bzhin gsol ba btab ste/ de kho na nyid kyi rang bzhin du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang kho na dang tha mi dad pa'i phyir de gsungs pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ e yi cha byad bzang po gang*// dbus su waṃ gis rnam par brgyan// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// zhes pa tshig gis rgyas par bshad par bya'o// de nas gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang yon gyis mnyes par byas te/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes brjod par bya'o// lha mo gtso bo la yang dbang gong ma gsum ni sgros mthun pa nyid phyag rgyas phyag rgya bsten pa'ang pho lus su bsgyur ba'i nges pa bshad pa'o// 'dir ni yid kyis dmigs pa yin pas gang yang mi 'gal lo// de ltar mai tri zhabs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga zhang zhung mar ngo'i 'gyur gnyis la mar pa jo sras kyis slar bcos shing dag par byas pa ji lta ba pad+ma dkar pos nas mor bris pa'o/// /maṅga laṃ/// /
